statusText: Mapped policy state: WATCH; delayed NQ remains substantially repaired from the session low, while a fresh rise in long yields, oil above $100 and the 17:00 UTC Apple event keep risk concentrated.
recommendation: Mapped policy state remains WATCH. Tail is below the blocking threshold because meaningful intraday repair is visible; re-escalation would require renewed one-way extension, shallow failed retracements or sustained extreme-holding.
headline: NQ repair keeps Tail at WATCH as yields and oil remain severe
body: The latest retrieved delayed September NQ reference was 29,529.75, about 197 points above the 29,333 session low and 9 points below the prior close. Treasury announced a September 10 bond-repurchase operation of up to $6 billion; Reuters reported the 10-year yield reached 4.8528% after the announcement. Brent remained above $100 amid renewed U.S.-Iran escalation. Current post-announcement NQ microstructure is not available at comparable freshness.

sources.title: Reuters: US Treasury to buy up to $6 billion in Sept 10 buyback operation
Reuters: Wall St slides as oil hovers near $100 on rising Middle East tensions

lookbackSummary: Across the preceding 24 clock-hours, published Tail ranged from 16% to 43%. High/red conditions appeared at 11:00, 13:00 and 14:00 UTC; the 12:00 UTC slot is unavailable, and the 15:00 UTC assessment had already repaired to WATCH.
outlookSummary: Current repair keeps Tail at WATCH, while oil above $100, long yields near multi-year highs and the Apple event keep Stress extreme. Tomorrow's PPI and claims create the next major checkpoint; future Tail remains conditional on observed continuation, retracement quality and cross-asset alignment.

forecast.analysis: Latest retrieved delayed Sep NQ was 29,529.75, about 197 points above the 29,333 session low and 9 points below the prior close. The repaired path limits Tail, while the fresh Treasury yield rise and oil shock keep Stress extreme.
drivers: NQ remains substantially repaired from the session low
10-year yield reached about 4.85% after the Treasury buyback announcement

news.title: US Treasury to buy up to $6 billion in Sept 10 buyback operation
Wall St slides as oil hovers near $100 on rising Middle East tensions

forecast.analysis: The Apple event is a concentration checkpoint. Tail remains WATCH unless a broad technology move develops with shallow or failed NQ retracements; two-way price discovery would keep the repaired-path interpretation intact.
After the Apple checkpoint, WATCH assumes price discovery remains two-way. A broad index response with repeated extension would raise Tail, while orderly retracements would support de-escalation.
Later in the session, lower Tail is conditional on meaningful retracements remaining available. Renewed directional efficiency near a session extreme would invalidate that assumption.
Power-hour risk stays at WATCH because late-session continuation can become efficient quickly. The score assumes no fresh one-way extension has been observed in advance.
Into the cash close, WATCH assumes the earlier repair has not broken down. A closing drive with shallow pullbacks would raise conditional Tail; balanced closing flows would lower it.
After the cash close, low Tail assumes session-directional pressure is no longer compounding. Oil and rates can keep Stress extreme without proving a persistent NQ path.
Early after-hours risk is lower absent a new catalyst, but thinner liquidity can magnify moves. Persistent overnight extension would be the condition for renewed Tail escalation.
Low Tail is the base case if overnight trade remains two-way. The geopolitical backdrop keeps Stress elevated even without evidence of mean-reversion failure.
The overnight base case remains low Tail. A new oil or geopolitical discontinuity would raise Stress first and Tail only if NQ develops persistent directional structure.
During the Asia transition, low Tail assumes no sustained directional handoff. Cross-market alignment would matter more if NQ begins holding near an overnight extreme.
Asian-hours risk remains conditional. Divergent regional equity performance would favor mixed structure, while aligned risk-off movement with failed NQ repair would raise Tail.
Approaching Europe, Tail remains below WATCH if overnight ranges continue to retrace. Persistent oil and yield pressure keeps the environment difficult despite the lower path risk.
The European open is a structure checkpoint. Tail stays low if directional moves retrace meaningfully; shallow pullbacks and repeated extension would move the state higher.
WATCH begins as the next U.S. inflation sequence approaches. Event proximity raises Stress, while Tail remains dependent on observed price structure rather than the scheduled release itself.
drivers: PPI approaches later in the day

forecast.analysis: Morning European trade remains at WATCH because oil and rates can amplify a directional handoff. The score assumes NQ has not yet established persistent failed retracements.
As U.S. premarket liquidity builds, WATCH reflects greater sensitivity to inflation expectations. Tail would rise only if premarket NQ begins showing sustained one-way structure.
The pre-PPI window carries higher conditional Tail because rates and oil are already stressed. The score still assumes no future release outcome and no future price path as known.
Near the inflation release window, WATCH reflects event concentration and fragile rates. Any higher Tail would require the actual post-release NQ path to show persistent extension or failed repair.
drivers: Initial claims shares the 12:30 UTC window

forecast.analysis: The 12:00 UTC hour contains the 12:30 PPI and claims checkpoint. Tail stays at WATCH before results are known; the decisive evidence would be the observed post-release retracement pattern.
After the scheduled data, WATCH is conditional on orderly price discovery. A sustained second leg with shallow pullbacks would justify escalation; fast repair would argue for lower Tail.
Near the U.S. cash-open transition, WATCH assumes no persistent continuation has been observed in advance. Opening-auction extension and failed pullbacks would be the key escalation evidence.
During the first full cash hour, WATCH assumes two-way trade after the data and open. Continued extreme-holding with aligned semis, breadth and yields would raise Tail.
Later in the morning, WATCH assumes the event impulse has begun to normalize. Persistent one-way structure would invalidate that base case; ordinary retracements would support de-escalation.

forecastDetail.comment: Observed delayed NQ remains well off the session low, but the fresh Treasury yield rise and oil above $100 keep the current state at WATCH.
The Apple event is a conditional concentration point; escalation depends on a broad, persistent NQ response rather than the event itself.
Post-event WATCH assumes two-way discovery; repeated extension after failed retracements would be the escalation condition.
Lower late-session Tail assumes meaningful pullbacks remain available; renewed extreme-holding would invalidate that assumption.
Power-hour WATCH reflects conditional continuation risk without treating a future directional move as already observed.
At the cash close, WATCH assumes the repaired structure persists; shallow closing pullbacks would raise conditional Tail.
